(Persistent Storage)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="180" x="260" y="670" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="dockerfile" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="image" value="docker build"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="image" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="registry" value="docker push"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="registry" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="pulled" value="docker pull"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="pulled" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;" target="c1" value="docker run"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="pulled" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;" target="c2" value="docker run"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="c1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;" target="volume" value="mount"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="c2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;" target="volume" value="mount"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
